name: pollora/meilifacets
description: Faceted search, filtering and suggestions powered by Meilisearch for Pollora projects.

suggest.ext-intl: Orders facet values as the site language does; without it, DisplayOrder::Name falls back to a byte comparison that misplaces accented labels.

scripts-descriptions.fix: Apply the formatting the linter asks for.
scripts-descriptions.refactor: Report what Rector would change, without changing it.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the tests that need nothing but this package.
scripts-descriptions.test:host: Run the tests that need a host application, from the host project.
scripts-descriptions.lint:js: Check the browser client for dead code and unused imports.
scripts-descriptions.types:js: Type-check the browser client and its tests.
scripts-descriptions.build: Bundle the browser client into resources/assets/dist.
scripts-descriptions.build:check: Fail when the committed bundle does not match the sources.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything the module can verify on its own: the definition of done.
